description:
Advances: ueberauth_asgard.authorization_code
Ready-for: implement

Deliverable:
Extend the existing Ueberauth Asgard strategy with per-login state, nonce and S256 PKCE. Verify callback state/nonce, pass code_verifier to token exchange, retain refresh_token and token expiry in Ueberauth credentials, and accept offline_access scope. Remove logging of options, token bodies and client secrets. Preserve existing id-token consumers while making code login secure. Document the contract and add meaningful tests. This library has no existing Ancora corpus; document its behavior in a small repo spec without adopting unrelated application infrastructure.

Verification:
Authorization URL contains S256 challenge but no verifier or secret; matching code callback sends verifier and returns verified user/access/refresh credentials. Reject state, nonce, issuer, audience, signature and expiry failures. Captured logs contain no test secrets or tokens. Run library tests and formatting in a container, then consumer integration tests in Atlas and Builder.

Out of Scope (files):
Primary checkout and untracked test_bypass.exs, Builder/Atlas application auth stores.
Allowed touches:
Library strategy, Client/OpenID helpers, tests, README/spec and version metadata in a linked worktree.
Out of Scope (intent):
No independent application auth stack, no production merge or deployment.
Merge gate:
Real PR against main, tests and consumer checks pass. Builder PR 164 remains unchanged.
Evidence:
Current main 7203af2 lacks code_verifier and refresh_token fields. Strategy/OpenID debug logs interpolate client options including client_secret. This blocks new issuer code+PKCE login in the assigned Builder/Atlas OBO work.

Keep feat/asgard-pkce-refresh until both consumers repin to the merged main commit. Deleting the branch after squash made the still-pinned 4286fa66900d3c6460e96cb7036f8e343e971e40 unavailable to Mix's normal fetch and caused Atlas's production image build to fail before deployment. Restored the branch at that exact commit and verified a fresh clone checks it out successfully. No source change. Atlas's failed build is being rerun after this concrete fix.

title: Support PKCE code login and rotating refresh credentials without secret logging
